description: Dispatch an autonomous AI agent to execute specific test cases. The agent opens a real browser, navigates the app, follows the test case's steps, and reports results. A test case without steps runs as it is: the agent follows its description and the run records the steps it took (unless you set stepsGenerationRequested: false on that test case, to keep it intent-only), so never generate steps first just to be able to run it. Tests run ASYNCHRONOUSLY (1-3 minutes). This tool returns tracking info confirming dispatch — NOT final results. Do NOT interpret the response as pass/fail. Poll wopee_fetch_recent_executions or wopee_fetch_executed_test_cases every 30-60 s for the verdict (inside the Commander Assistant, results also arrive as a chat notification). Prerequisite: test cases must exist in the suite (generate with wopee_generate_artifact type USER_STORIES_WITH_TEST_CASES).

analysisIdentifier.description: Analysis identifier of the suite to dispatch the agent for

suiteUuid.description: UUID of the suite to dispatch the agent for

testCases.description: Chosen test cases to dispatch the agent for

stepsGenerationRequested.description: Whether a PASSED run of a step-less test case saves the steps the agent took (default: true). Set false to keep the test case intent-only. A test case that already has steps is never changed.

testCaseId.description: ID of the test case belonging to the user story to dispatch the agent for (ex. TC001)

userStoryId.description: ID of the user story that the test case belongs to (ex. US001)

name: wopee_dispatch_agent
title: Dispatch autonomous testing agent
